children.design_delta_summary: Keep the tag-42 protocol-owned outer envelope from the stronger parent line, then add two pCID-selected payload protocols: a per-promiser port-implementation promise record for first-port auditability, and a service-observation protocol that distinguishes kept/refused/timeout/corrupt outcomes while carrying CID-rooted reference and freeze-successor fields.

culling.reason: Rejected under DI-ditan: superseded by Hozif; Vinag retains two tightly coupled pCID-selected payload protocols plus service/dispatch/support vocabulary that conflicts with anti-RPC and pCID-stability rubric refinements.
